function velocity_to_lines(vf::VelocityField)
    # --- Cubic B-spline interpolation implementation ---
    # Reconstruct 3D arrays for velocity components
    ux_3d = reshape(vf.ux, vf.nx, vf.ny, vf.nz)
    uy_3d = reshape(vf.uy, vf.nx, vf.ny, vf.nz)
    uz_3d = reshape(vf.uz, vf.nx, vf.ny, vf.nz)

    # Get unique sorted grid points for each axis
    x_grid = sort(unique(vf.x))
    y_grid = sort(unique(vf.y))
    z_grid = sort(unique(vf.z))

    # Convert to LinRange for Interpolations.jl scaling
    x_range = LinRange(x_grid[1], x_grid[end], length(x_grid))
    y_range = LinRange(y_grid[1], y_grid[end], length(y_grid))
    z_range = LinRange(z_grid[1], z_grid[end], length(z_grid))

    # Create a function to interpolate the velocity field at a given point
    # and return all three velocity components: u = (ux, uy, uz)
    function interpolated_vector_field(point)
        x, y, z = Float64.(point)
        return Point3f(
            interpolated_getindex(ux_3d, (x_range, y_range, z_range), x, y, z),
            interpolated_getindex(uy_3d, (x_range, y_range, z_range), x, y, z),
            interpolated_getindex(uz_3d, (x_range, y_range, z_range), x, y, z)
        )
    end

    # Get the streamline density from the UI settings
    streamline_density = vf.ui_states.streamline_settings

    # Create a streamplot with the interpolated vector field

    minimaxi = extrema.((vf.x, vf.y, vf.z))
    mini = Vec3f(first.(minimaxi))
    maxi = Vec3f(last.(minimaxi))
    limits = Rect3f(mini, maxi .- mini)
    return streamplot_impl(Point, interpolated_vector_field, limits, (32, 32, 32), 0.01, 20, streamline_density, norm)
end

function velocity_to_lines(vf::VelocityField)
    # --- Cubic B-spline interpolation implementation ---
    # Extract x, y, z components from xyz
    x = [p[1] for p in vf.xyz]
    y = [p[2] for p in vf.xyz]
    z = [p[3] for p in vf.xyz]
    
    # Extract velocity components from u
    ux = [v[1] for v in vf.u]
    uy = [v[2] for v in vf.u]
    uz = [v[3] for v in vf.u]
    
    # Reconstruct 3D arrays for velocity components
    ux_3d = reshape(ux, vf.nx, vf.ny, vf.nz)
    uy_3d = reshape(uy, vf.nx, vf.ny, vf.nz)
    uz_3d = reshape(uz, vf.nx, vf.ny, vf.nz)

    # Get unique sorted grid points for each axis
    x_grid = sort(unique(x))
    y_grid = sort(unique(y))
    z_grid = sort(unique(z))

    # Convert to LinRange for Interpolations.jl scaling
    x_range = LinRange(x_grid[1], x_grid[end], length(x_grid))
    y_range = LinRange(y_grid[1], y_grid[end], length(y_grid))
    z_range = LinRange(z_grid[1], z_grid[end], length(z_grid))

    # Create a function to interpolate the velocity field at a given point
    # and return all three velocity components: u = (ux, uy, uz)
    function interpolated_vector_field(point)
        x, y, z = Float64.(point)
        return Point3f(
            interpolated_getindex(ux_3d, (x_range, y_range, z_range), x, y, z),
            interpolated_getindex(uy_3d, (x_range, y_range, z_range), x, y, z),
            interpolated_getindex(uz_3d, (x_range, y_range, z_range), x, y, z)
        )
    end

    # Get the streamline density from the UI settings
    streamline_density = vf.ui_states.streamline_settings

    # Create a streamplot with the interpolated vector field

    minimaxi = extrema.((x, y, z))
    mini = Vec3f(first.(minimaxi))
    maxi = Vec3f(last.(minimaxi))
    limits = Rect3f(mini, maxi .- mini)
    return streamplot_impl(Point, interpolated_vector_field, limits, (32, 32, 32), 0.01, 20, streamline_density, norm)
end
